description_for_human: Review Azure security posture findings and recommendations.
description_for_model: Call getAuthContext and setAuthContext successfully before any assessment operation. Use only the token tenant and subscriptions returned by live delegated discovery. Stop on authentication or scope validation errors and preserve the API error category, status, message, and remediation guidance exactly.

functions.name: getAuthContext
functions.description: Mandatory first call. Discover the OAuth token tenant and Azure tenants and subscriptions visible through delegated RBAC. Do not ask for or infer scope before this call succeeds.

functions.name: setAuthContext
functions.description: Mandatory second call. Validate a target tenant and subscription selection against the delegated OAuth token and live Azure access. Stop on any mismatch or denied subscription.

functions.name: getAssessmentSummary
functions.description: Get or compute a read-only Azure security posture assessment summary.

functions.name: getSecurityFindings
functions.description: Get filtered evidence-backed Azure security findings.

functions.name: getRecommendations
functions.description: Get recommendations derived from the latest grounded findings.

functions.name: runReadOnlyAssessment
functions.description: Run a live read-only assessment for selected Azure subscriptions.
